description: This file defines the SportsTab widget, which is a stateless Flutter widget for the sports tab in a tabbed UI. It imports Flutter material package, constants, and category tab widget, and builds a CategoryTab with the category set to 'sports'.

classes.name: SportsTab
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the sports tab in the application.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the SportsTab, returning a CategoryTab widget configured for the 'sports' category.
